statement: For 2025, FUTA tax is 6.0% on the first $7,000 of wages paid to each employee during the calendar year, paid by the employer only; timely state unemployment contributions earn a credit of up to 5.4%, leaving a net 0.6% (at most $42 per employee) with the full credit; wages subject to the unemployment laws of a credit reduction state (one that has not repaid federal unemployment loans) incur additional FUTA tax (Instructions for Form 940, 2025).
caveat: The credit depends on timely state payments and the state's loan status, which change annually (Schedule A); the wage base and rate are statutory (§§ 3301-3302) but the credit-reduction list is a yearly determination. Figures carry their asOf date — verify the live instructions.
